_comment: GDPR data retention policies. Run via cli/gdpr-gc.php (--dry-run default, --apply triggers BackupService snapshot first).
_legal_basis: Art.5(1)(e) GDPR (storage limitation). Legal retention overrides for accounting (SK Act 431/2002 = 10 years for invoices).

email_log.rationale: Debug retention. Keep template+status+adapter+sent_at for stats; scrub PII fields.

audit_log_entries.rationale: After 24m, scrub the IP address and the change payload (old/new value, note) but keep entity+action+actor+timestamp for compliance trail.

coupon_uses.rationale: Hash email after 24m — preserves dedup logic but de-identifies PII.

orders_pii.rationale: Accounting records of the seller's country (stores.json legal.country), counted from the order to the end of the period that runs from the end of its year: SK 10 y (Act 431/2002 §35), CZ 10 y (VAT Act 235/2004 §35), DE 10 y (AO §147), AT 7 y (BAO §132), PL 5 y from the end of the tax year (Ordynacja podatkowa art. 86/70), HU 8 y (Act C/2000 §169) — each plus one year. Other countries: ttl_days. After it, scrub PII; keep numeric/legal columns. LAWYER TO REVIEW the periods.

orders_contact.rationale: Not accounting data: the IP address (fraud checks), phone (delivery) and the free-text note serve the delivery, done within months. Only shipped or closed orders (an unshipped one still needs them; a shipped order 180 days old is long delivered, also when no carrier reported it); empty fields stay empty; refund ids and ERP markers in the note are internal records and stay. Name, e-mail and address stay under orders_pii.

complaints_pii.rationale: Decided complaints (reklamácie): the record and written decision serve the 24-month liability (Directive (EU) 2019/771) and the seller's complaint register (SK: kept 3 years). After 5 years from receipt the name, e-mail, defect description and decision note are erased; number, order, item, remedy and dates stay. An undecided complaint is never touched. LAWYER TO REVIEW the period.

withdrawal_requests_pii.rationale: A withdrawal statement is proof of the withdrawal (Directive 2011/83/EU art. 11a) for claims about the refund. After 5 years from receipt the name, e-mail and optional reason are erased; order, items, receipt time and confirmation status stay. LAWYER TO REVIEW the period.

rma_requests_text.rationale: Closed returns (RMA): the free-text reason and admin note can name the customer. After 5 years they are erased; the RMA number, order, lines and credit-note link stay for the accounting trail (the credit note itself is preserved). An open RMA is never touched. LAWYER TO REVIEW the period.

return_receipts_note.rationale: Warehouse note on a received return line; erased with the RMA texts after 5 years. Quantity and disposition stay. LAWYER TO REVIEW the period.

promotion_runs.rationale: Ended catalog promotion runs only count for the Omnibus prior price within one year after they end (Promotions::catalogRulesWithEnded); older ones are never read again.

price_list_runs.rationale: Ended price-list runs only count for the Omnibus prior price within one year after they end (Pricing::priceListRowsWithEnded); older ones are never read again.

cookie_consent_old.rationale: ePrivacy proof window — keep 24m of consent records for regulator queries.

preserved._comment: These tables are explicitly EXCLUDED from automatic retention (legal/business reasons).
preserved.invoices: 10y legal retention (SK Act 431/2002). Manual purge only after legal counsel review.
preserved.payment_transactions: Legal/financial audit trail. Manual purge only.
